events.title: StoneEra Demo 0.9.16.3 — Halloween Update
events.summary: Halloween has arrived in StoneEra! Update 0.9.16.3 brings pumpkins, warm lantern light and a new collection of decorations for your settlement. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46262112/ef6fe9fac200401a472fde0f74e62bfadc0a2101.png Grow your own pumpkins New Camp and House starts receive six pumpkin seeds. Plant them, let them grow for three game days without watering, then harvest pumpkins and recover a seed to plant again. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46262112/8c611416d872eab6721f99acc983c5f72de34281.png 14 Halloween

events.title: StoneEra Demo 0.9.16.2 — First Steps
events.summary: Demo 0.9.16.2 is now available for Windows and macOS. We have added a clear, step-by-step tutorial for the first minutes after placing your camp. Mark a tree for cutting and let your Woodcutter harvest it. Build a Carpenter workbench, order planks and wait for production. Expand storage and complete your first shelter. Follow instructions and buttons that open the right menu. Objectives advance when the work is actually done. Your tutorial progress is saved. House starts recognize the workbench

events.title: StoneEra Demo 0.9.16.1 — Sound & Community
events.summary: This small demo update focuses on sound and feedback. Softer, warmer gameplay sound effects with better balance in busy colonies. New layered wind, rain, river, fire and waterwheel ambience. Natural footstep and animal-call pacing at higher game speeds. Refreshed UI click, confirmation and error sounds. A new Report a bug · Discord button in the main menu. Found a bug or have feedback? Join us on Discord. Thanks for helping improve StoneEra! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46262112/a9c9fcdada70414594b9297883

events.title: Steam Next Fest: Build Your First StoneEra Settlement
events.summary: StoneEra is taking part in Steam Next Fest, and I'd love to see what you build! Start with a small camp in an editable voxel world. Guide your villagers as they gather resources, build, and research early technologies. Your first goal: smelt a copper bar. The free demo includes 12 early technologies and 11 Steam achievements, with no session timer. Save your world and keep building after reaching that first milestone. events.title: StoneEra Demo 0.9.16 — Building, Weather & Colony Life
events.summary: Version 0.9.16 brings a livelier settlement and more convenient construction. Residents organize building work more effectively, weather changes with the seasons, and beavers begin reshaping rivers. Camp or a ready-built house Choose a traditional camp or a wooden house with five beds, a workbench, a campfire and covered storage when creating a world. events.summary: StoneEra Demo 0.9.15.1 — Flow & Foundations is now available for Windows and macOS. This update opens more hands-on water building in the Demo and improves how residents reach, carry out and recover from their work. Waterworks in the Demo Waterworks (W1) now unlocks the waterwheel, medium and large norias, and wooden/stone channels in the Demo. events.title: StoneEra 0.9.13 — Technological Era: Research & an Untimed Demo
events.summary: Hello, settlers! StoneEra 0.9.13 — Technological Era brings research to your colony, a refreshed interface, and a new way to play the free demo. Research grows with your settlement The new Research menu maps out 28 technologies across six branches: Food, Construction, Clothing, Metal, Waterworks and Transport. See what each discovery unlocks, which materials it needs, and what comes next. The demo includes 12 of these early technologies; later discoveries are clearly marked as full-game content.

events.title: StoneEra Demo Is Live — Build Your First Colony!
events.summary: The free StoneEra demo is now available on Steam, with 60 minutes of gameplay to start your own medieval voxel settlement. Choose a place to settle, give your villagers their first jobs, and turn a small camp into a colony shaped by your ideas. What you can explore in the demo Build and reshape the world.
